machine_range_classification.rule: Without a pre-approved prospective qualifying scientific window, persisted historical ranges are classified P1.

governance_blocker_classification.reason: The binding blocker register assigns DATA_GAP disposition P0 regardless of individual historical range labels.

ambiguity.reason: The blocker register uses the phrase frozen qualifying window, while the remediation plan and V2-B01 measures require a prospectively defined qualifying interval.
ambiguity.required_resolution: A human Governance and Integrity decision must declare the qualifying interval before any range priority is accepted.

fail_closed_effect: No readiness gate is promoted. V2-B02 remains an open P0 blocker, and every range overlapping a later approved qualifying interval must be reclassified P0 until independently disposed.
